identificationModule.briefTitle: S0226 Anastrozole With or Without Fulvestrant as First-Line Therapy in Postmenopausal Women With Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase III Randomized Trial of Anastrozole Versus Anastrozole and Fulvestrant as First Line Therapy for Post Menopausal Women With Metastatic Breast Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm I
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral anastrozole once daily on days 1-28.

armGroups.label: Arm II
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral anastrozole as in arm I. Patients also receive fulvestrant intramuscularly on days 1, 14, and 28 during course 1 and then on day 28 of the subsequent courses.
